# Meta Quest controller models (for VR)

From the WebXR Input Profiles assets (`@webxr-input-profiles/assets` 1.0.20, MIT — see LICENSE.md):
`meta-quest-touch-plus` (Quest 3 / 3S), `meta-quest-touch-pro` (Quest Pro) and `oculus-touch-v3` (Quest 2).

The textures were taken out (so no logos are drawn) — `rbx/vr.js` paints the controllers in
Neoblox's logo colours instead, and moves their buttons, trigger and thumbstick as you press them.
